groups.label: Prefix-Safe Context Isolation

groups.note: Parent 'Containing the Blast Radius of Autonomous AI' is a legitimate general position; -256 narrowed it to one paper's engineering mechanism (sidecar manifests, trace isolation) with 0 situation_refs. source_refs are deliberately NOT folded onto the parent (build_manifest.py's REF_FIELDS already excludes source_refs) -- the parent is a general-risk node, not a Dream-RSI-specific one, and inheriting a single-paper citation would misrepresent what it's about. Per SO condition C1 (e/398#2): fold_edges is false -- all 5 of -256's edges are AI-discovered, status:proposed, and never reviewed, discovered for the narrow Dream-RSI claim. A child's relations (including a TENSION_WITH) don't inherit upward to a general parent the same way a duplicate-merge's do. The edges stay on -256, going dormant with the superseded node; if any relation is independently valid for -140, it should be proposed fresh through edge discovery on the parent, not carried by the fold.
groups.survivor_basis: editorial: -256 is an over-specific child of its own existing parent -140, not a duplicate of any sibling node
